latin: Sicut et uidetur et auditur homo ab homine per motionem sensus ad extra, ita et uidetur et auditur demon ab homine et a demone per motionem sensus ad intra.
translation: A man is seen and heard by another man through a sense-motion directed outward; in the same way, a demon is seen and heard—by a man, or by another demon—through a sense-motion directed inward.
